# f5xc_active_service_policies (Data Source)

SetActiveServicePolicies SetActiveServicePolicies sets the active service policies for the namespace An emtpy list in the request will clear the active service policies for the namespace

- `service_policies` (Attributes List) service_policies Service Policies is a sequential engine where policies (and rules within the policy) are evaluated one after the other. It's important to define the correct order (policies evaluated from top to bottom in the list) for service policies, to get the intended result.
